name: Service Dependency Check
description: Verifies a configurable set of systemd services AND a configurable set of Docker containers are running and healthy. Reports each as state=running/inactive/failed; lists everything that is NOT in the desired state. Fails when any required service or container isn't running so the alert pipeline reacts immediately.

inputs.name: requiredServices
inputs.description: Space-separated systemd unit names that must be active

inputs.name: requiredContainers
inputs.description: Space-separated container names that must be Up

steps.description: is-active for each required systemd unit; reports name=state per line
steps.command: ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} 'for s in ${inputs.requiredServices}; do printf "%s=%s " "$s" "$(systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"; done; echo'

steps.description: Fail (exit 6) when any required systemd unit isn't active. Lists offenders.
steps.command: BAD=$(ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o ConnectTimeout=5 ${inputs.host} 'for s in ${inputs.requiredServices}; do st=$(systemctl is-active "$s" 2>/dev/null || echo missing); [ "$st" = "active" ] || printf "%s(%s) " "$s" "$st"; done'); if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then echo "NOT_ACTIVE: $BAD"; exit 6; else echo 'all required systemd units active'; fi

steps.description: Inspect each required container's State.Status + Health (when present)
steps.command: for c in ${inputs.requiredContainers}; do S=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo missing); H=$(docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo none); printf "%s=%s/%s " "$c" "$S" "$H"; done; echo

steps.description: Fail (exit 7) when any required container isn't running, or is unhealthy
steps.command: BAD=''; for c in ${inputs.requiredContainers}; do S=$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Status}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo missing); H=$(docker inspect -f '{{if .State.Health}}{{.State.Health.Status}}{{else}}none{{end}}' "$c" 2>/dev/null || echo none); if [ "$S" != "running" ] || [ "$H" = "unhealthy" ]; then BAD="$BAD$c($S/$H) "; fi; done; if [ -n "$BAD" ]; then echo "NOT_HEALTHY: $BAD"; exit 7; else echo 'all required containers running + healthy'; fi

steps.description: Rollup. systemd_check.ok=false → restart the unit; container_check.ok=false → docker restart / inspect logs.
steps.command: echo "ServiceDependencyCheck on ${inputs.host}: systemd_ok=${steps.systemd_check.ok} containers_ok=${steps.container_check.ok}. If systemd_ok=false, action: 'sudo systemctl restart <unit>'. If containers_ok=false, action: 'docker logs <name>' then 'docker restart <name>'."
